keywords.name: deviation-lognormal
keywords.description: A log-normal distribution is used to assign the property values randomly. In other words, the natural logarithm of property values is a Gaussian distribution with a mean of fvalue and standard deviation of f . Because fvalue is the mean of the logarithm, 18 gives values near 7e7, and a value such as 1e8 overflows.
